# Evelyn Goldfinch — Author of A Star So Far from Heaven

> The official website of author and musician Evelyn Goldfinch, featuring her memoir A Star So Far from Heaven, a true story of one woman's daring decision and life-changing journey in search of love and self-worth.

## About

- [About the Author](https://evelyngoldfinchbooks.com/#about): Evelyn Goldfinch is a musician and author from a small town in the hills of Pennsylvania, where she lives with her two cats, Moses and Mirabel.
- [About the Book](https://evelyngoldfinchbooks.com/#book): Synopsis of A Star So Far from Heaven, a profoundly moving memoir about an ordinary cleaning day, a single letter written long ago, and the events that followed.

## Book

- [Read a Sample — In the Beginning](https://evelyngoldfinchbooks.com/#excerpt): The opening chapter excerpt, which begins on an ordinary Tuesday, the day the author cleans her house.
- [Praise and Reader Reviews](https://evelyngoldfinchbooks.com/#praise): Reader reviews of the memoir, including words from Dave, Emily O. and Hobie S., Counselor.
- [Buy A Star So Far from Heaven](https://www.amazon.com/Star-So-Far-Heaven-Self-Worth/dp/B0F16TDM1S/): Paperback edition available on Amazon.
- [Read on Kindle](https://www.amazon.com/Star-So-Far-Heaven-Self-Worth-ebook/dp/B0FDLJP7X5/): Kindle ebook edition available on Amazon.

## FAQ
